publisher_assessment.publisher: Alþingi (Icelandic Parliament) and official public authorities
publisher_assessment.decision: Accept the listed government-published links for their stated, limited uses. The current Alþingi consolidated-law pages are accepted as external references in Icelandic.
publisher_assessment.basis: The publisher and instrument identities are clear. Alþingi current law pages display Lagasafn edition 158a dated 1 October 2026. The official Ministry of Justice immigration page links to Alþingi, Reglugerðasafn and published appeal decisions. The Courts Administration publishes Rules No. 3/2022 on its official court-service network and identifies its effective date and repeal of the 2019 rule.
publisher_assessment.limitation: These are accepted external references, not accepted local copies, completed topic assessments, or a completed Iceland review. The linked Regulation 540/2017 base text predates three listed 2026 amendments and is accepted only as the official record and amendment index. Court decision publication rules are accepted, but completeness of the court search for immigration decisions is not established.

accepted_references.title: Foreign Nationals Act No. 80/2016
accepted_references.acceptance_scope: Official current consolidated statutory text, including Chapter XI and the Icelandic EEA/EFTA provisions, for reference and issue-led legal review.
accepted_references.limitations: The page notes parts of Act 48/2026 take effect on 2026-12-01. Keep enacted-but-not-yet-effective provisions distinct from rules in force on the review date.

accepted_references.title: Administrative Procedure Act No. 37/1993
accepted_references.acceptance_scope: Official current consolidated general administrative procedure text for issue-led review.
accepted_references.limitations: Applicability of individual provisions to immigration decisions remains to be mapped.

accepted_references.title: Act No. 2/1993 on the European Economic Area
accepted_references.acceptance_scope: Official current consolidated EEA framework legislation, to be read with the EEA Agreement and relevant Icelandic implementing law.
accepted_references.limitations: This reference does not by itself establish the content or scope of every EEA-incorporated act.

accepted_references.title: Information Act No. 140/2012
accepted_references.acceptance_scope: Official current consolidated text on public access to government information and records.
accepted_references.limitations: How particular access provisions apply to an individual immigration file requires issue-specific review.

accepted_references.title: Data Protection Act No. 90/2018
accepted_references.acceptance_scope: Official current consolidated Icelandic data-protection statute, including the national framework for GDPR rights and remedies.
accepted_references.limitations: The relevant EEA-incorporated GDPR text and the competent authority's current complaint procedure remain separate references.

accepted_references.title: Regulation No. 540/2017 official record and amendment index
accepted_references.acceptance_scope: Official identity and amendment-index page for Regulation 540/2017.
accepted_references.limitations: Not accepted as a current consolidated text: the page's linked base text retains provisions replaced by later listed amendments.

accepted_references.title: EFTA EEA-Lex record for Directive 2004/38/EC and JCD 158/2007
accepted_references.acceptance_scope: Official EFTA record for the Directive 2004/38/EC and its EEA incorporation by Joint Committee Decision 158/2007. Use as an EEA legal-reference record, not as Icelandic national implementing law.
accepted_references.limitations: The current review viewer returned 403 when re-opening the page on 2026-10-21. The record was inspected in the 2026-10-18 inventory; recheck current EEA status when material to a specific issue.

accepted_references.title: Rules No. 3/2022 on online publication of court decisions and orders
accepted_references.acceptance_scope: Current official rules on online publication of court decisions and orders, including publication timing, exceptions and privacy measures. The text says the rules took effect 2022-10-01 and repealed Rules No. 3/2019.
accepted_references.limitations: The rule does not establish completeness of the online court-decision corpus or of immigration case-law discovery.

accepted_references.title: Ministry of Justice immigration overview and official source directory
accepted_references.acceptance_scope: Official navigation and authority-identification page; it links to immigration laws, regulations, the Directorate of Immigration, the appeals board, and published board decisions.
accepted_references.limitations: Discovery reference only; substantive rights and procedure must be reviewed at the linked legal or competent-authority source.

accepted_references.title: Regulation 669/2026 amending Regulation 540/2017
accepted_references.acceptance_scope: Official amendment text: repeals §41 and changes the terminology in §47; the §47 terminology change took effect 2026-07-01.
accepted_references.limitations: Accepted as the published amendment, not a consolidated version of Regulation 540/2017.

accepted_references.title: Regulation 724/2026 amending Regulation 540/2017
accepted_references.acceptance_scope: Official amendment text: replaces §11, adds an exception to §13, inserts §38a on reliability assessment of documents, repeals §43b, and adds §52. It entered into force on publication/issuance as stated in the text.
accepted_references.limitations: The text states immediate entry into force; it is dated 2026-06-11 and the record gives a 2026-06-26 publication date. Use both dates as displayed and resolve the exact effective date only if material to the issue.

accepted_references.title: Regulation 725/2026 amending Regulation 540/2017
accepted_references.acceptance_scope: Official amendment text replacing Chapter II with short-term residence-permit provisions; the regulation states that it entered into force immediately.
accepted_references.limitations: The text states immediate entry into force; it is dated 2026-06-11 and the record gives a 2026-06-26 publication date. Use both dates as displayed and resolve the exact effective date only if material to the issue.

accepted_references.title: Courts Act No. 50/2016
accepted_references.acceptance_scope: Current official consolidated court-organization and judicial-administration law, including provisions cited by Rules No. 3/2022.
accepted_references.limitations: The applicable judicial challenge route and procedure for a particular immigration decision remain to be mapped.

accepted_references.title: Act No. 91/1991 on Civil Procedure
accepted_references.acceptance_scope: Current official consolidated general civil-procedure text.
accepted_references.limitations: Do not assume it governs every immigration judicial-review action; determine applicable jurisdiction and procedure for the specific claim.

human_review_sites.publisher: Ísland.is and the responsible agencies publishing immigration-service pages
human_review_sites.review_note: Review the portal-wide ownership and update context for the relevant immigration and registration pages. The Registers Iceland page says over three months in its body but six months in its title/form, while the Directorate entry page says six months. Decide which agency-published page is reliable for each use and reconcile the legal threshold against the accepted statutes.

human_review_sites.publisher: Kærunefnd útlendingamála (Immigration Appeals Board) and Stjórnarráðið
human_review_sites.review_note: Confirm current appeal instructions, deadlines, publication scope, and how redactions affect discovery. Published decisions are selective and do not establish a complete decision corpus.

Review the current Dómasafn search route and its practical coverage. Rules No. 3/2022 are accepted separately; portal search completeness, treatment of immigration judgments, and the separate Supreme Court, Landsréttur and district-court repositories remain open.

The official record and Iceland/JCD 158/2007 reference were inspected in the 18 October review, but direct re-opening returned 403 in the 21 October viewer. The link is accepted as the official incorporation-record reference; review the portal if current EEA status is material to a specific issue.

not_accepted_as_current_text.reason: The linked Regulation 540/2017 text predates amendments 669/2026, 724/2026 and 725/2026. Its official record is accepted only as an identity and amendment index; use the three amendment texts for their scoped changes.
Rules No. 3/2019 are superseded; Rules No. 3/2022 state they took effect on 2022-10-01 and repealed the 2019 rules.

completion_note: Fourteen official links are accepted for the limited scopes recorded above. This does not accept any local copies or complete any topic. Iceland review remains incomplete: registration guidance conflicts, court-search completeness and ongoing case-law discovery need review, the immigration judicial-remedy route needs mapping, and operational guidance, visa/mission, regional and continuing-discovery work remains open.
